IntegrationRegistration.description: A registration, by the kind of external system it connects to.

GithubRegistration.description: A connection to GitHub, watching one repository.

repository.description: The repository it watches, as owner/name.

installation.description: The ID of the installation the App was installed as.

carries.description: The directions it carries. Absent means both.

interval.description: How often the poll reads the App's Delivery log, as a duration such as `1m` or `PT30S`.

webhook_secret.description: The App's webhook secret. Given one, a Delivery that reaches kestrel's webhook is recorded on arrival; the repository is polled either way.

WebhookRegistration.description: A generic endpoint any producer can POST CloudEvents to. It carries inbound only.

secret.description: The secret a sender presents as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

carries.description: The directions it carries. Absent means inbound.

IntegrationState.description: Disabled pauses every use of an Integration and keeps everything it resumes with. Retired ends every use for good and keeps only what its history refers to.

IntegrationRetirement.description: The explicit choice to retire an Integration.

revision.description: The revision the retirement was decided against.

CanceledPost.description: Something a Session said that will not be posted where its work came from.

turn.description: The Turn whose response it was; null for the Session's own Outcome.

attempted_at.description: When a request for it had already gone out; the comment may be there all the same.

IntegrationChange.description: What maintenance may change; an omitted field keeps its value.

carries.description: Every direction it carries afterwards; a generic webhook carries inbound only.

interval.description: How often a GitHub Integration's poll reads its App's Delivery log, as a positive duration.

revision.description: The revision this change was decided against.

base.description: Public HTTPS origin; omitted to use the deployment setting.

pending_url.description: An unfinished URL update; retry set-url with the same base to finish it, including after restart.

status_code.description: HTTP result recorded by GitHub; null when unavailable.

IntegrationWebhookSecretRotation.description: The choice to rotate a GitHub Integration's webhook secret. kestrel makes the replacement; it is never named here.

revision.description: The revision this rotation was decided against.

IntegrationPrivateKeyReplacement.description: A replacement for the private key a GitHub Integration signs as its App with. The App, installation and repository it is checked against are the Integration's own and cannot be named.

private_key.description: The App's RSA private key, in PEM.

revision.description: The revision this replacement was decided against.

Integration.description: A registered Integration. What it presents to the external system is never part of it.

repository.description: The repository a GitHub Integration watches.

bot_login.description: The App's own bot account, `<slug>[bot]`, learned from GitHub when a GitHub Integration was registered.

revision.description: Bumped by every change, so a Client can say which one it decided against.

canceled_posts.description: What retiring it left unsaid, each with why.

polled_every.description: How often it is polled, when it is.

webhook_path.description: Where on the link GitHub, or a generic producer, can deliver to it. An inbound GitHub Integration is also polled.

diagnostic.description: Why it is out of use now, with the steps that resume it when any do; null while it is in use.

webhook_secret_rotation.description: Its unfinished webhook-secret rotation; null when none is under way.

WebhookSecretRotation.description: An unfinished webhook-secret rotation. Until it finishes, a delivery signed with either the previous or the replacement secret is accepted.

attempted_at.description: When GitHub was last asked to set it; null before it is asked.

diagnostic.description: Where it stands and how to finish it: how the last attempt failed, or that nothing said how it ended.

EventRefusal.description: The latest Event an Integration refused rather than stored, or the Deliveries it lost to GitHub's retention, visible until acknowledged.

id.description: The refused Event's id; null when Deliveries were lost rather than one refused.
